name: Language Tutor
description: English conversation and focused skill practice with a dedicated learning coach, saved challenges, and guided reviews.

commands.title: Speech to Text
commands.description: Converts recorded audio (base64) to text using the Mocu STT model.

commands.title: New Conversation
commands.description: Creates a fresh conversation or a focused-practice session for a selected difficulty.

commands.title: Get Conversation
commands.description: Returns a saved conversation with all its messages.

commands.title: Save Conversation Topic
commands.description: Saves a topic or description on one specific conversation.

commands.title: Get Learning Progress
commands.description: Returns saved grammar issues, practice streaks, and mastered items.

commands.title: Ask English Tutor
commands.description: Routes messages to the general conversation or focused-practice coach based on the selected mode, then saves conversation turns and validated learning progress.

commands.title: Text to Speech
commands.description: Converts input text to audio using the Mocu TTS model and returns it as base64.
